description:
**IT Technical Project Manager**

**Experience:** 4 Years  
**Company:** Kretoss Technology LLP  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office  
**Note:** Only Gujarat\-based candidates can apply.

About the Role

Kretoss Technology LLP is looking for an experienced **IT Technical Project Manager** with 4\+ years of experience in managing software development projects, technical teams, clients, timelines, and project delivery. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of software development processes and the ability to coordinate effectively between clients, developers, QA, UI/UX, and management.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage **end\-to\-end IT/software development projects** from requirement gathering to final delivery.
* Understand project requirements, define scope, timelines, milestones, and deliverables.
* Coordinate with **developers, QA, UI/UX designers, business teams, and clients** to ensure smooth project execution.
* Convert business requirements into clear technical tasks and project plans.
* Prepare and maintain **project schedules, task assignments, timelines, and priorities**.
* Track daily project progress and ensure tasks are completed within agreed deadlines.
* Identify project risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and resource constraints and take corrective actions.
* Conduct regular **project status meetings** and provide progress updates to management and clients.
* Communicate effectively with clients regarding requirements, progress, changes, issues, and delivery timelines.
* Manage **scope changes, change requests, and project priorities** while maintaining delivery commitments.
* Work closely with technical teams to understand architecture, development challenges, integrations, APIs, databases, deployments, and technical dependencies.
* Ensure proper coordination between **development and QA teams** for testing, bug fixing, UAT, and final deployment.
* Monitor project quality and ensure development follows defined technical and business standards.
* Review project documentation, requirements, estimates, and deliverables.
* Maintain proper project documentation including **BRD/FRD, SRS, project plans, meeting notes, status reports, and delivery documents**.
* Ensure timely deployment and successful project handover to the client.
* Monitor post\-production issues and coordinate with technical teams for timely resolution.
* Support management in **resource planning, project estimation, and team allocation**.
* Identify opportunities to improve project processes, productivity, and delivery efficiency.

Technical Knowledge Required

* Strong understanding of **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**.
* Good understanding of **Agile / Scrum methodologies**.
* Experience working with project management tools such as **Jira, Trello, ClickUp, Asana, or similar platforms**.
* Understanding of **Web Applications, Mobile Applications, APIs, Databases, and Cloud environments**.
* Basic understanding of technologies such as **.NET, PHP/Laravel, Node.js, React/Angular, Flutter/iOS/Android, Shopify**, or similar development technologies.
* Understanding of **REST APIs, third\-party integrations, databases, Git, deployment, and CI/CD**.
* Ability to understand technical requirements and communicate them effectively to development teams.
* Basic understanding of **AWS/Azure/Cloud platforms** is an advantage.
* Understanding of **QA processes, testing, bug tracking, UAT, and production releases**.

Key Requirements

* **4\+ years of experience** in IT Project Management / Technical Project Management.
* Proven experience managing **software development projects from initiation to delivery**.
* Strong experience in **client communication and stakeholder management**.
* Excellent project planning, task management, prioritization, and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of technical concepts and software development processes.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to identify project risks and take proactive corrective actions.
* Strong leadership and team coordination skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of project delivery.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to deadlines.
* Experience working with **international clients** will be an added advantage.

Must\-Have Skills

**Project Management \| SDLC \| Agile/Scrum \| Client Communication \| Team Management \| Requirement Gathering \| Project Planning \| Risk Management \| Jira/Project Management Tools \| Technical Understanding \| QA \& UAT \| API \& Integration Understanding \| Deployment \& Production Support**

Preferred Candidate

The ideal candidate should be a **hands\-on Technical Project Manager**, not only a task coordinator. The candidate must be comfortable communicating with clients as well as developers, understanding technical challenges, managing project priorities, and taking ownership of **end\-to\-end project delivery**.

Pay: From ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**About Us:**

BW Converting is a strategic alliance of resources and services that bring together several Barry\-Wehmiller companies — Paper Converting Machine Company (PCMC), Winkler \+ Dünnebier (W\+D), STAX Technologies, Hudson\-Sharp, Baldwin Technologies and Northern Engraving and Machine. These industry leaders offer trusted brands and innovative technologies in the design, manufacture, and service of high\-performance converting and packaging machinery for the tissue, nonwovens, hygiene, bag\-converting, mailing, and printing industries.  

  

Barry\-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper\-converting industries. By blending people\-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose\-driven growth, Barry\-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.  

  

**Job Description:**

**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**

At Barry\-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.  



What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well\-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.  



In India, Barry\-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry\-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.  



**Our culture is built on:**

* Ownership – Drive features end\-to\-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results\-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.

**Career Development and Global Exposure**

  

At Barry\-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world\-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting\-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.  



If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high\-impact, future\-focused environment—where long\-term stability meets start\-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.

* High attention to detail and accuracy

Needs to be a local resident to the office

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Planning and execution
* Administrative excellence
* Stakeholder engagement
* Communication
* Risk management
* Time management
* Attention to detail
* Adaptability
Professionalism and integrity  
* 

**Qualification \& Experience**
-------------------------------

* Degree in Engineering, Project Management or Business Administration, or a related field
* 5\+ years of project co\-ordination experience
* Experience managing projects in India
* Experience providing extensive administrative and operational project support
Project Management certification would be preferred

**Travel:**

* May need to travel up to10% each year based on requirements.

Barry\-Wehmiller is a place where you can bring your best self to life through the work that you do — no matter the path you choose.

**Job Title\- Project Manager**

  

**Location: Naroda**

  

Experience\- 8\-10 years

  

**About us:**

  

Ingersoll Rand advances the quality of life by creating comfortable, sustainable and efficient environments. Our products, systems and solutions increase the efficiency and productivity of industrial, commercial operations, homes, and improve the health and comfort of people around the world. We have opportunities for career growth through our diverse businesses which manufacture and service many well\-recognized brands.

For our CSS division we are looking for a Project Manager who will lead multiple projects, ensuring alignment with internal and contractual requirements. The Project Manager will act as the central controller for all project\-related activities, coordinating cross\-functional teams and maintaining strong communication with stakeholders. This role also contributes to the development of processes and tools in collaboration with other Project Managers.

* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and closure of the assigned projects.
* Develop and maintain project schedules, cost control, risk registers, and status reporting.
* Identify and resolve with the team any potential deviations from the approved project plan and manage critical paths to achieve milestone goals.
* Coordinate internal functions, i.e. engineering, procurement, manufacturing and QA/QC.
* Facilitate consensus decisions and conflict resolution within the team
* Communicate project status, issues, risks, and activities; chair meetings and maintain minutes.
* Manage project costs and drive improvements in cost ratio
* Ensure key milestones are met within time and cost constraints, while adhering to proper quality requirements.
* Ensure goods and deliverables are supplied by Project requirements.
* Build trust\-based relationships with Customers, acting as main point of contact.
* Share best practices across the organization.
* Collaborate with engineering, quality, procurement, and vendors to track deliverables
* Support audits and client reviews with accurate documentation.

* 5\+ years’ experience in leading major projects in Oil \& Gas environment
* Lean knowledge valued
* PMP certification or equivalent valued
* Proven techniques / methods for resolving issues and conflicts
* Process oriented and self\-directed
* Strong verbal, communication, and presentation skills
* Ability to develop detailed project timelines / schedules
* High proficiency in Microsoft Project, Excel, Word and Power Point

* Familiarity with industry standards (e.g., ISO 9001, API, ASME, etc.).
* Excellent organizational and stakeholder communication skills.
* Fluency in English required.
* Management and Industrial / Mechanical engineering degree preferred

  

**Key competencies:**

  

* Project Management
* Stakeholder communication
* Conflict resolution
* Process improvement
* Customer focus
* Drive for results
* Integrity and Trust
* Collaboration and Teamwork

  

**What we offer:**

  

* Dynamic international working environment
* Smart working policy and flexible working time
* Welfare program
* LinkedIn Learning access
* Inclusive and diverse culture, that values different backgrounds and experiences

  

Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology\-driven excellence in mission\-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40\+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions.
